sn47.35:1.2: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending.
sn47.35:1.3: This is our instruction to you.
sn47.35:2.1: “And how, bhikkhus, is a bhikkhu mindful?
sn47.35:2.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body …
sn47.35:2.5: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.35:2.6: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu is mindful.
sn47.35:3.1: “And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu exercise clear comprehension?
sn47.35:3.2: Here, bhikkhus, for a bhikkhu feelings are understood as they arise, understood as they remain present, understood as they pass away.
sn47.35:3.3: Thoughts are understood as they arise, understood as they remain present, understood as they pass away.
sn47.35:3.4: Perceptions are understood as they arise, understood as they remain present, understood as they pass away.
sn47.35:3.5: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu exercises clear comprehension.
sn47.35:3.6: “Bhikkhus, a bhikkhu should dwell mindful and clearly comprehending.
sn47.35:3.7: This is our instruction to you.”
